checks.name: Scoped roots span the directory and contain the one accessible head
Children paginate beyond twenty without duplicates
Foreign legal-entity anchors are forbidden in both focus and child endpoints
Expanding a node loads its first twenty direct reports
Load more retains previous children and shows the whole branch
Nested reporting can be followed through five levels
Collapse hides descendant controls
Focus opens one permitted position with an explicit filter notice
Tree node opens the real position detail
Position detail can become the reporting focus
Date change removes a reparented node from its former branch
Date change exposes the node under its new parent
Search promotes a matching node whose parent is outside filters
Keyboard expansion works with native buttons
A failed tree request displays retry and clears old branch data
Retry reloads a live scoped tree
Branch roots redact hidden parent identifiers
Guessed hidden parent focus is forbidden
Arabic mobile expands the scoped deep branch
Arabic RTL tree fits the mobile viewport
Role without hierarchy access receives a clear list fallback
Unscoped user cannot focus an otherwise valid position
Revocation applies to previously visible focus and child anchors
Revocation removes roots
No runtime exceptions, HTTP 5xx or external requests
Source unchanged during verification

limits: Synthetic permission/date/navigation proof; not sustained-load certification or HR acceptance.
One controlled network abort tests UI retry; business and permission data use real personal sessions.
No source mutation, real HR data, external email or production migration.
